title: Binary expansion of a predecessor
statement: For every natural number $n$, the binary bit list of $n-1$ (with subtraction truncated at zero) is obtained from the binary bit list of $n$ by replacing each initial $0$ by $1$ until the first $1$, then deleting that $1$; if the list consists only of that $1$, it becomes empty.
